notes.title: [Patch Note #4] Bug Fixes & UI Improvements
notes.notes:
1. System Improvement

 The speed of the algorithm that calculates revenue has been doubled.
 A system message will be displayed when calculating revenue by E train to avoid confusion with screen freezes.
 Detailed rules are added in the Tutorial.
 Now UI that includes stock share and related income will be displayed when purchasing stocks and calculating income.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41219738/299302f7ad224a1e40eeb043af2a80cd68ad58da.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41219738/05e6794b0605e6bbebabf5118044641eea51ffce.png



2. Bug Fixes
-System
 Fixed the issue when trains could not be acquired from other companies in the situation of forced train purchase.
 Fixed the issue when the controlling shareholder's rights were transferred in the situation of forced purchase of trains by AI.
 Fixed the issue when you could participate in the IPO even if your stock holdings reached the maximum.

-Asset Cards
 Fixed the issue related to the function of the 'Defector' card.
 Fixed the issue that the 'Refugee' card did provide any money to its owner.
 Fixed the issue that the effect was not activated even when using the 'Outer Station
Construction' card.



3. UI Improvement

 The range of the pass button has been modified.
 The income display of Northern sea and continent tiles is shown to the green era.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41219738/a5c8bb4e74c85d61d9d2dae5dadd0656fc5029d8.png

notes.title: [Patch Note #3] Changes & Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
1. Changes

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41219738/ef009c337dd243859e474500c70c0e699779c5c1.png
 The revenue of continent and ocean tiles near Rason is increased by 20. (50->70, 40->60) 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41219738/77bb8453ca3161181551691e2f122877955653e0.png
 The position of a tile under the Busan has moved above.
* As the position of a tile has moved, previous save files may not be available after the patch.


2. Bug Fix

UI
 Fixed an issue that revenue of continent and ocean tiles are not displayed as their actual revenue.

Asset Card
 Fixed an issue that occurs when a company with 'Miracle on the Han River' is bankrupt.
 Fixed an issue that occurs when a company activates 'Additional Station' and 'Defector' together.

AI
 Fixed an issue that AI passes turn right after starting IPO.

notes.title: [Patch Note #2] AI (beta) & Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
1. AI(beta)
Now you can add AI players in local & online play.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41219738/44cf32836a3960aa1617ec3482b7c450b4d06969.gif

Local
In the waiting room, set the number of players.
Click + or - button to change a local player into an AI player or return it to a local player.

Online
Click + or - button to add an AI player or delete it.

2. 'Defector' UI
Now UI for 'Defector' is displayed when the 'Defector' asset card is activated after the Korean War.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41219738/90cd76dfae6af9cd45800fce3588f80b8c9ccec7.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41219738/08886ea2ef47a3a4be043a9e53855fd71ab7b661.png


3. Bug Report
When you find any significant issue during the play, it's more efficient to fix it if you provide us with play data. We've made the report button on the upper side of the screen.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41219738/b957101748b4f84d228a5647ad508fbccb66fb57.png

When you access the report screen and click the 'save' button.
2 player log files will be created on your desktop. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41219738/b847e868a776576372204a6b112bfd520a2aa22c.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41219738/3ab78e1e7fc74841052d690609b60b23179a3dc3.png

Send us those files by bug report channel of Discord.
We'll check the issue and fix it as soon as possible.ːsteamhappyː

Bug Fixed

 Revenue auto calculating algorithm has been improved.
 Description of asset cards that did not clearly explain its effect has been improved.
 Fixed a bug that "Analyst" asset card sometimes made stock price jump triple times.
 Fixed a bug that buying stock from a bank funds company.

notes.title: [Patch Note #1] UI Improvements & Bug Fix
notes.notes:
Hi, all! Thanks for your support and feedback after the game release.
We have updated some elements and fixed issues that you report to us through Steam community and 18Korea's Discord channel.


1. Tutorial

Asset cards are added in tutorial
- Now you can check all 30 asset cards in the tutorial.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41219738/c3c99cb192c6a79bcb493c525a38e43ecad513b8.png

Tutorial is added in setting
- Now you can open the tutorial tab during the game by opening the setting tab.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41219738/f8ba445efe7a3720bc3ce8fdc55e0b617fc84a4a.png

Illustration about Korean War added.
- Illustration images about Korean War are added in the tutorial.



2. UI

Diaplay of max and the current amount of train
- Now you can check the maximum amount of trains depending on the era and the current amount of trains that the company has.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41219738/39a8195f00ff1284697b554b84ba7923d50d0968.png


Display of the sum of every train line 
- Now you can check the sum of every train line's revenue.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41219738/9f1f9df1ff3cee8625d356d1d12d0ea0ee7facbb.png



3. Bug Fix

Issues related to bankrupt
 - Fixed issues related to bankrut.
